description: We are Star Seekers, a passionate team interested in space, technology, AI, web development, and creative problem-solving. We are looking for teammates interested in coding, UI/UX, AI/ML, data analysis, research, visualization, or presentation. Join us to share ideas, learn together, and build an innovative NASA Space Apps project!
summary: Star Seekers presents Cosmora, an interactive space exploration and astronaut training platform that transforms space science into an engaging, hands-on educational experience. Students can train as astronauts, complete 18 space science missions, explore a 3D solar system, track near-Earth asteroids, observe real NASA data, and manage their own Moon or Mars outpost through a 30-sol survival simulation involving oxygen, food, water, energy, radiation protection, and emergency challenges. By combining NASA scientific resources, interactive simulations, quizzes, mission-based learning, and realistic space environments, Cosmora helps learners develop scientific curiosity, critical thinking, engineering knowledge, data interpretation, and problem-solving skills. Our goal is to empower the next generation of explorers by making the science and challenges of real space missions accessible to everyone.
details: Star Seekers presents Cosmora, an interactive space exploration and astronaut training platform designed to make space science more engaging and accessible for students, educators, and space enthusiasts. The platform allows users to experience astronaut training, explore an interactive 3D solar system, complete space missions, investigate asteroids, monitor planetary environments, and manage a simulated Moon or Mars outpost. It combines educational activities, realistic simulations, interactive visualizations, and scientific resources from NASA to help learners understand real-world space exploration. Through mission-based learning and resource-management challenges involving oxygen, food, water, energy, and radiation protection, Cosmora develops scientific curiosity, critical thinking, engineering knowledge, data interpretation, and problem-solving skills while inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
